name: entropy-data-skills
description: Ready-made analyses for Entropy Data: governance landscape report, duplicate data products, PII exposure, access review, data product health, contract change review, test failure root cause, and data discovery.

interface.shortDescription: Ready-made analyses for governance, data product owners, and builders.
interface.longDescription: Outcome-focused analyses on top of the entropy-data CLI. Governance: landscape report, duplicate data product finder, PII exposure scanner, access review. Data product owners: health briefing, contract change review. Data product builders: data discovery and fitness check, test failure root cause analysis. Read-only unless you confirm an action.
defaultPrompt: Create the governance landscape report for our organization.
Do we have duplicate data products?
How are the data products of my team doing?
What breaks if I change this data contract?
